base.note: Focused dashboard-planning correction over the deployed/audited v1.6.2 baseline.

changes.V002_HIGH_BLOCKING_RULE_163: Only non-observed MUY_ALTA/ALTA unseen questions block MEDIA134. OBSERVADA_* high remains historical exposure but is non-blocking.
changes.MEDIA134_UNLOCK_163: When highValidUnseen is zero and daysExam >= 3, the daily plan opens MEDIA134 even if highObservedUnseen remains positive.
changes.HIGH_OBSERVED_INTERLEAVE_163: Adds an explicit high_observed daily task capped at 20 questions after MEDIA134, preserving historical exposure without displacing MEDIA acquisition.
changes.P0_FIRST_163: Errors/doubts remain first in the MEDIA phase, followed by MEDIA134, historical high exposure, due review and speed automation.
changes.V162_PRESERVED: Three-digit simulator numbering, fixed doubt slot, candidate/discard controls and decision telemetry are unchanged.
changes.PROTECTED_SESSION_FILES: session-core.js and session-storage.js remain byte-identical to the protected baseline.

supabase_migration.note: No migration. This patch changes only frontend plan orchestration.

dataset_revision_note: Supabase postcheck confirmed 195 questions updated, 2 flags resolved, 195 history rows, 44 open flags remaining.

qa.manual_smoke: Verify visible v1.6.3; with 0 high valid and high observed remaining, Dashboard shows MEDIA 134 before the high-observed historical block; v1.6.2 simulator and decision telemetry remain unchanged.
